title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Revelation 17: the woman on the scarlet-colored beast and the angel’s explanation of the mystery.

questions.text: What did one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls say he would show the narrator?
questions.explanation: The angel said, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters.”

answers.text: The marriage supper of the Lamb
The new Jerusalem coming out of heaven
The pit of the abyss being opened
The judgment of the great prostitute

questions.text: What was the woman sitting on when the narrator was carried away into the wilderness?
questions.explanation: He saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

answers.text: A scarlet-colored beast with seven heads and ten horns
A white horse with a crowned rider
A beast with two horns like a lamb
A throne of glass mixed with fire

questions.text: What did the woman hold in her hand?
questions.explanation: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet and decked with gold, precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and impurities.

answers.text: A balance for weighing grain
A reed like a measuring rod
A golden cup full of abominations
A censer full of incense

questions.text: According to the name written on her forehead, of what is Babylon the great called the mother?
questions.explanation: On her forehead a name was written: “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

answers.text: The kings and the princes of the earth
The prostitutes and the abominations of the earth
The nations and the languages of the earth
The beasts and the false prophets

questions.text: With what was the woman drunken?
questions.explanation: The narrator saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus, and wondered with great amazement.

answers.text: With the blood of the saints and martyrs
With the wine of the wrath of God
With the water of the great river
With the oil and the wine of the earth

questions.text: What does the angel say the seven heads are?
questions.explanation: The angel said that the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

answers.text: Seven assemblies of the saints
Seven plagues that are yet to come
Seven mountains on which the woman sits
Seven angels who stand before God

questions.text: What does the angel say about the ten horns?
questions.explanation: The angel said the ten horns are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

answers.text: Ten mountains where the woman sits
Ten kings who receive authority for one hour
Ten plagues poured out of the bowls
The ten tribes that were sealed

questions.text: What will happen when the kings war against the Lamb?
questions.explanation: They will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings.

answers.text: They will overcome the Lamb for a short time
The war will last forty-two months
The Lamb will give them his throne
The Lamb will overcome them

questions.text: What does the angel say the waters where the prostitute sits are?
questions.explanation: The angel said that the waters, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.

answers.text: Peoples, multitudes, nations and languages
The springs of life-giving waters
The great river Euphrates
The sea of glass before the throne

questions.text: What will the ten horns and the beast do to the prostitute?
questions.explanation: These will hate the prostitute, make her desolate, strip her naked, eat her flesh and burn her utterly with fire.

answers.text: They will give her their thrones
They will carry her into the wilderness
They will hate her and burn her utterly with fire
They will hide her in the rocks of the mountains
